decision: Add an explicit assertion-artifact requirement path to thos_publication_guard rather than silently requiring assertion artifacts for every phase.

implementation.expected_negative_assertions: assertion_status FAIL_BLOCKER with assertion_failures present when file name marks expected-negative evidence

claim_boundary: The guard flag records local THOS publication-readiness evidence only. It does not authorize connector writes, certify security, validate GMUT, close GMUT gates, prove fifth-force safety, or prove consciousness claims.
